messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@symphonyhealth.com>, Mike Jacobs <m.jacobs@symphonyhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Warm pass: Symphony Health - Sprint 0 kickoff & steward assignment

Hi Laura / Mike —

Great to close this out last week — excited to get Symphony across the finish line. Per our commitment, planning notes and immediate asks below so CS can pick up sprint 0 and own delivery through acceptance: please treat this as the warm pass.

Deal summary (TL;DR)
- SKU: Redwood Hosted API + Dedicated capacity (dedicated pool for Prod)
- Go-live target: 2027-01-15 (internal target, negotiable based on SSO configuration)
- Initial scope: embeddings + streaming chat for provider portal, 30k monthly active users estimate first year
- Contract & SOW: attached (Symphony_Implementation_SOW_v1.pdf)

What the customer expects from CS in Sprint 0 (high level)
1) Kickoff workshop with engineering and security (2 hours) — cover network, SSO, IP allowlists, and data residency expectations
2) Delivery of sprint0-checklist.xlsx (attached) with owners and acceptance criteria
3) Environment provisioning plan for staging and prod (ETA: 2 weeks from kickoff)
4) Weekly cadence: Mon 30-min check-in, escalation triage as needed

Known risks / open items
- SSO: Symphony needs Okta integration and SCIM provisioning — they asked about attribute mappings and deprovision timeline
- Data residency: they prefer us-east for production (confirmable)
- Procurement: PO expected by 2026-09-20; procurement@symphonyhealth.com looped in

Suggested first owner/contacts (please reassign if needed)
- Primary CS steward: Monica Patel (cc'd)
- Technical lead: Tessa Morgan (cc'd)
- RevOps / billing contact: Karthik Iyer (cc'd)

Next steps I need from the CS team by EOD Thu 9/10:
- Confirm steward and propose a 2-hour kickoff window next week (Mon/Wed preferred)
- Confirm SSO owners and security pre-reqs to surface to the customer
- Quick read on any capacity/quant constraints for dedicated pool (Tessa)

Attachments: Symphony_Implementation_SOW_v1.pdf, sprint0-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll stay on the thread for first two meetings to smooth handoff.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Warm pass: Symphony Health - Sprint 0 kickoff & steward assignment

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers from our side:
- Okta + SCIM is required; our IdP team will need attribute list and test account details before the kickoff.
- Data residency: US-East is preferred for Prod; staging can be in the region you recommend.
- PO ETA: aiming for 9/18 but we’ll try to hit 9/15. Procurement cc'd here.

Would it be possible to get a short doc that lists the exact SAML attributes we expect and the recommended SCIM schema? If Monica/Tessa can share that ahead of the kickoff it would help our IdP team prep.

Also — we have an internal compliance checkpoint on 9/22 for audit readiness; if Sprint 0 can wrap the security questionnaire before then that would be ideal.

On the kickoff cadences: Wed 9/15 morning PST works for our engineering leads.

Laura
